描述_EN: square of dark blue monochrome tapestry added by stitching on a linen ground cloth. the tapestry is decorated with an ecru geometric design on a dark blue background using a flying shuttle. two parallel poly-lobed stripes, separated by a plain stripe, form a square. its center features a new square adorned with a network of interlacing.
描述_ZN: 方的深蓝色单色挂毯在亚麻底布上缝制而成的。 该挂毯在深蓝色的背景上用飞梭装饰了一个赤褐色的几何图案。 两道平行的多裂纹，由一道平纹隔开，形成一个正方形。 其中心有一个新的广场，装饰着交错的网络。
